```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

d_gps <- 
  read_csv(here(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_gps_2023-07-31.csv")) %>%
  rename(lat = median_latitude,
         lon = median_longitude)

grappe_phase_mort <- readRDS(paste0(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_phase_2023-07-31.rds"))

```

### Collapse `grappe_phase_mort` to grappe-level outcome measures.
```{r}

grappe_mort <- 
  grappe_phase_mort %>%
  group_by(region, district, site_code, grappe,
           adaptive_rand, tx) %>%
  summarise(started_phase_1to59 = sum(started_phase_1to59, na.rm=T),
            pt_year_1to59 = sum(pt_year_1to59, na.rm=T),
            n_deaths_1to59 = sum(n_deaths_1to59, na.rm=T),
            n_alive_1to59 = sum(n_alive_1to59, na.rm=T),
            lost_1to59 = sum(lost_1to59, na.rm=T),
            
            started_phase_1to11 = sum(started_phase_1to11, na.rm=T),
            pt_year_1to11 = sum(pt_year_1to11, na.rm=T),
            n_deaths_1to11 = sum(n_deaths_1to11, na.rm=T),
            n_alive_1to11 = sum(n_alive_1to11, na.rm=T),
            lost_1to11 = sum(lost_1to11, na.rm=T),
            
            started_phase_12to59 = sum(started_phase_12to59, na.rm=T),
            pt_year_12to59 = sum(pt_year_12to59, na.rm=T),
            n_deaths_12to59 = sum(n_deaths_12to59, na.rm=T),
            n_alive_12to59 = sum(n_alive_12to59, na.rm=T),
            lost_12to59 = sum(lost_12to59, na.rm=T),
            
            deaths_per_1000_1to59 = n_deaths_1to59 * 1e3 / pt_year_1to59,
            deaths_per_1000_1to11 = n_deaths_1to11 * 1e3 / pt_year_1to11,
            deaths_per_1000_12to59 = n_deaths_12to59 * 1e3 / pt_year_12to59)

grappe_mort

length(unique(grappe_phase_mort$site_code))
length(unique(d_gps$site_code))

```

### Join gps to outcome data
```{r}
d_gps_latlon <-
  d_gps %>%
  dplyr::select(site_code, lat, lon)

grappe_mort_1 <- grappe_mort %>%
    left_join(d_gps_latlon, by=c("site_code")) %>%
  relocate(lat, .after=grappe) %>%
  relocate(lon, .after=grappe)

# confirm it was a clean 1:1 join
nrow(grappe_mort_1) == nrow(grappe_mort)
# nrow(grappe_mort_1) == nrow(d_gps) 

## d_gps has 2 more rows than grappe_mort

# Recode tx labels to align with ms nomenclature
grappe_mort_2 <- grappe_mort_1 %>%
  mutate(
  tx = case_when(
      tx == "1 - Azithro 1-59m" ~ "Child Azithro",
      tx == "2 - Azithro 1-11m" ~ "Infant Azithro",
      tx == "3 - Placebo 1-59m" ~ "Placebo"
      ),
  tx = factor(tx, levels = c(
    "Child Azithro",
    "Infant Azithro",
    "Placebo"))
  ) %>%
  # shorten adaptive randomization labels
  mutate(adaptive_rand = factor(adaptive_rand, 
                                levels = c("Random Allocation 1", 
                                           "Random Allocation 2", 
                                           "Random Allocation 3"),
                                labels = c("Randomization 1", 
                                           "Randomization 2", 
                                           "Randomization 3")))

grappe_gps_mort <- 
  grappe_mort_2 %>%
  filter(district=="Dosso")

grappe_gps_mort

```

# Map grappes (communities)

```{r convert to spatial data}
#-------------------------------
# format grappe data as sf
#-------------------------------
d_sf <- st_as_sf(grappe_gps_mort, coords=c("lon","lat"), 
                 crs=4326) # set coordinate ref system to WGS1984

```

```{r download admin shapes}

#-------------------------------
# load administrative boundaries
# downloaded from 
# humanitarian data exchange
# https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner?
#-------------------------------

niger_adm0 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm00_feb2018/NER_adm00_feb2018.shp"))
niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm01_feb2018/NER_adm01_feb2018.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm02_feb2018/NER_adm02_feb2018.shp"))

# filter admin level 2 subdistricts to just Dosso and Tahoua
niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
  # filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"))
  filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso")) ## for initial analysis, just doing Dosso

#-------------------------------
# create a zoom window, and
# a cropped version of the admin
# polygons
#-------------------------------
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
niger_dists_cr <- st_crop(niger_adm1, xmin = 0, xmax = 7,
                                    ymin = 11, ymax = 19)

```

## Spatial predictions of diarrhea and ATE
```{r}
#---------------------------
# identify the bounding box
# around subdistricts that
# contain the WASHB Bangladesh
# clusters
#---------------------------
b_boxgrid <- st_make_grid(niger_adm2,
                          n=c(100,100),
                          what = "centers"
                          )

#-------------------------
# data frame for
# diarrhea spatial modeling
#-------------------------
bpairs_diar <- dbgps %>% filter(outcome_lab=="Diarrhea") %>% ungroup()

#-------------------------
# fit spatial model for
# diarrhea prevalence in 
# the control group
#-------------------------
(b_fitdiar <- spaMM::fitme(Y0bar ~  lat + lon + Matern(1|lat + lon),
                           data = bpairs_diar,
                           family = gaussian(link = "identity")) )

```


```{r map grappes}
# zoomed out overview of Niger
plot_niger_admin <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm1, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    # geom_sf(data=niger_gadm0_sf, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 7, ymin = 11, ymax = 19), color = "black", fill = NA, lty = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # add country labels
    annotate("text",x=4,y=22, label = "Niger", fontface="bold",size=8) +
    labs(x="",y="") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "pt")
        )
    
plot_niger_admin

pcols <- brewer_pal(palette = "YlOrRd")(9)[c(3,5,7,9)]
    
# detailed zoom view, including grappes
plot_map_mortrate_1to59 <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf, aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59),size=0.75, alpha=0.9, pch=19) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", title="") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_map_mortrate_1to11 <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf, aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to11),size=0.75, alpha=0.9, pch=19) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_map_mortrate_12to59 <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf, aes(color=deaths_per_1000_12to59),size=0.75, alpha=0.9, pch=19) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

# Composite figure

```{r make overall composite, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}

layout <- "
AB
AC
AC
"
patchwork_fig1 <-  
  plot_map_mortrate_1to59 + 
  plot_map_mortrate_1to11 + 
  plot_map_mortrate_12to59 +
  # plot_layout(design = layout, widths = c(0.7,0.3)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

patchwork_fig1

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-mortality-rate-point-est-map.pdf"), 
       patchwork_fig1,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 250,
       height = 160,
       units = "mm")
```
